page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, operating at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring that each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor, providing virtualization infrastructure for resource management. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration. No GPU hardware is present on this server.

The dedicated core allocation model offers predictable compute performance by eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading. This design provides high resource density for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution. However, the lack of bundled local storage represents a tradeoff, as storage-heavy workloads will incur additional latency and cost from external block storage volumes. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a balanced, general-purpose resource.

The ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is designed for large-scale enterprise applications, high-concurrency web serving, distributed databases, and compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated physical cores. It is also suitable for batch processing, CI/CD pipelines, and application servers that benefit from high network throughput and predictable CPU performance.
